name: tsh-stack-react-native
description: TSH conventions for React Native 0.88 code on iOS and Android: the same standard as frontend code — Figma first, design tokens, three UI states, named exports, module boundaries — plus the rules a device adds: text inside Text, virtualized lists, safe areas and keyboard, touch targets, platform-specific code, and secrets in Keychain or Keystore. Also screen-reader accessibility on iOS and Android: VoiceOver and TalkBack roles and labels, focus and announcements, large text, and reduced motion. A read-only reviewer agent checks React Native changes against both.
